name: claude-session-restore
description: Snapshots the Claude Code sessions running in each window's terminals and resumes them after VS Code or the Mac restarts.

commands.title: Claude Restore: Resume sessions from last snapshot
Claude Restore: Show this window's snapshot

claudeRestore.mode.description: On window start, if Claude sessions from the last snapshot are no longer running: ask, resume automatically, or do nothing.

claudeRestore.intervalSeconds.description: How often to snapshot this window's Claude sessions.
